title: Fix Docker Container Restart Loop
brief: A containerized application keeps crashing and restarting immediately after startup. The startup script at /app/start.sh exits with an error, causing a restart loop. Your task is to identify the issue and fix it so the application runs continuously and serves HTTP requests on port 8080.
hints: Check the startup script at /app/start.sh - what does it do before starting the app?
The script checks for a file at /app/config.json - does it exist?
You can either create the missing file or modify the script to handle its absence gracefully
Test your fix by running: /app/start.sh (it should not exit immediately)
Once fixed, the app should be accessible at: curl http://localhost:8080
